title: TRICARE Select Line Reprocessed for the Catastrophic Cap - Liability and Payment Computation
content:
**Scope.** The computation covers the reprocessed line of a **TRICARE Select** enrollee who is the only member of the sponsor family enrolled in Select, read from the enrollee's own Select enrollment carrying the family's fee billing under an individual fee arrangement, whose Select enrollment took effect in the plan year that contains the adjudication date, and who holds no TRICARE Prime enrollment or exactly one that took effect in that same plan year, so that the family's deductible and catastrophic totals are the enrollee's own and every claim line and every installment whose coverage period has begun on that enrollment, and every Prime claim line and Prime installment of the enrollee, belongs to that calendar plan year; for any other enrollee it settles nothing. A fee-exempt enrollment carries no fee arrangement from which the family's Select membership can be read, so the fee-exempt tiers (the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers) are outside this calculation by design. Plan years are calendar years of 12 months, reckoned on the calendar from 2000-01-01.

## Computation clause

The amount a line reprocessed for the catastrophic cap is paid on is the reversed line's allowed amount. With other health insurance on file, the amount it is cost-shared on is the allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, never below zero; otherwise it is the allowed amount. Its liability is the deductible it takes - the smaller of the amount cost-shared and the tier's individual deductible less the deductible already applied on the enrollment's claim lines net of reversals (never below zero), and nothing for a service class in the tier's deductible-exempt service classes or network preventive care - plus the cost share the tier's outpatient basis gives for its network relationship and service class on what is left (the tier's non-network outpatient percentage outside the network, its network durable medical equipment percentage for network durable medical equipment, the network copayment for network preventive care or on a fixed-copayment tier, never more than what is left, and the tier's network outpatient percentage otherwise), rounded to the cent. The beneficiary liability on a line reprocessed for the catastrophic cap is that liability, and TRICARE pays as primary payer: the allowed amount less that liability, rounded to the cent and never below zero.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Tier and line | Allowed | Deductible taken | Cost share | Liability | TRICARE payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A (individual deductible 150.00, network 20 percent), network specialty visit, 100.00 of deductible already applied | 500.00 | 50.00 | 20 percent of 450.00: 90.00 | 140.00 | 360.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, network emergency room visit (exempt; copayment 112.00) | 600.00 | 0.00 | 112.00 | 112.00 | 488.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, non-network (25 percent), deductible met, other health insurance on file with 100.00 paid by the other insurer | 300.00 | 0.00 | 25 percent of 200.00: 50.00 | 50.00 | 250.00 |
